column1: # paragraph|location|cast@framing@authored action, four successive beats on unchanged camera axis

1|royal-hall|Colin,King,Steward@wide@Colin stops mid-performance as the King remains unsmiling and Steward looks away.|King@close_up@King gives Colin a small flat-mouthed dot-eye stare; no eyebrows.|Steward@close_up@Steward examines the cuff of his olive sleeve to avoid eye contact.|Colin@medium@Colin holds the marotte still and hesitates over whether to continue.

2|service-corridor|Colin@wide@Colin waits in the service corridor with marotte held at his side.|Colin@insert@A cloth hood bell and the wooden fool head are visible beside Colin's mitten hand, body cropped.|Colin,Steward@medium@Steward gives Colin a small instruction gesture near the doorway.|Colin@close_up@Colin listens carefully with a worried tiny mouth before entering the hall.

3|royal-hall|Colin@medium@Colin looks at the smiling wooden face of his marotte for guidance.|-@insert@The marotte's tiny painted fool face has a fixed cheerful smile, no real second person.|Colin@medium@Colin attempts a ridiculously elaborate bow while keeping the staff upright.|Steward,King@medium@Steward begins to smile while King still watches without laughing.

4|service-corridor|Colin@medium@Colin sits on the plain bench checking his work clothes before a gathering.|Steward,Colin@medium@Steward shows Colin that the hall is ready with an inviting open hand.|Colin@close_up@Colin brightens at the invitation, marotte upright and bell hood neat.|Colin@medium@Colin rises and checks the doorway again before the next performance.

5|royal-hall|Colin,King@wide@Colin stands before King in the established hall, a visible performer beside the raised chair.|Colin@medium@Colin politely mimics a ceremonial pose while holding his marotte like a sceptre.|Colin@insert@Colin's burgundy and ochre hood, small bells and mock staff are shown clearly without text.|Steward,King@medium@Steward reacts with a small amused mouth while King studies the parody.

6|service-corridor|Colin@medium@Colin adjusts a bell at the edge of his hood, making himself conspicuous.|-@insert@One small metal bell hangs from a cloth hood point, firmly stitched and not floating.|Colin,Steward@medium@Colin shifts near the doorway and Steward turns to notice him.|Colin@close_up@Colin freezes with an embarrassed tiny mouth after the bell draws attention.

7|service-corridor|-@insert@The plain wooden marotte lies on the bench beside the folded burgundy-ochre cloth hood.|Colin@medium@Colin holds the marotte and examines its simple construction.|-@insert@The little fool head is securely attached to the staff, with economical painted dot eyes.|Colin@medium@Colin replaces the hood neatly on his head without changing his costume.

8|royal-hall|Colin@medium@Colin holds the mock staff in a grand official stance near the centre of the hall.|Colin,Steward@insert@The wooden fool head points toward the closed account book held firmly in Steward's hands, bodies cropped.|Colin@close_up@Colin tilts his head toward the marotte as if listening to its opinion.|King@close_up@King glances toward the ridiculous prop with a small thoughtful head tilt; no eyebrows.

9|service-corridor|Steward,Colin@medium@Steward approaches Colin with a closed account book and explains an upcoming gathering.|Colin@close_up@Colin asks a practical question while holding the marotte lowered.|Steward@close_up@Steward gives a restrained cautioning hand gesture.|Colin,Steward@medium@Colin watches Steward walk toward the hall and considers the instruction.

10|royal-hall|Colin,King,Steward@wide@Colin watches from the side of the established hall as Steward speaks to King.|Steward@medium@Steward interrupts himself to wait for King's response.|King@close_up@King gives a small smile toward an off-frame remark.|Colin@close_up@Colin observes the reaction, silently revising his planned routine.

11|royal-hall|Steward@medium@Steward makes a very formal announcing gesture while holding the closed book.|Colin@medium@Colin copies Steward's grand announcing gesture with playful precision.|Steward@close_up@Steward's face becomes mildly uncomfortable at recognizing himself.|Colin@close_up@Colin notices the reaction and begins to lower his mock-official pose.

12|royal-hall|Colin@medium@Colin now announces himself with exaggerated dignity, holding marotte like an officer.|Colin@wide@Colin looks around for the impressive guest he appears to have announced.|Colin@close_up@Colin glances down at his own ridiculous costume and tiny staff.|Steward,King@medium@Steward relaxes into a smile while King enjoys the change of target.

13|royal-hall|Colin,King@medium@Colin stands at respectful distance from King with one questioning hand open.|Colin@insert@The tiny marotte head is held below the actual wooden chair's arm, showing ordinary scale.|King@close_up@King listens seriously rather than giving any ceremonial permission document.|Colin@medium@Colin lowers the staff and checks the audience's response before continuing.

14|service-corridor|Colin@medium@Colin sits on the bench after an awkward performance, head slightly bowed.|Steward@medium@Steward pauses at the hall doorway with a reserved expression.|Colin@close_up@Colin notices that the next invitation is uncertain and waits quietly.|Colin@insert@Colin's staff rests beside him on the bench, intact and ordinary; no weapons or execution imagery.

15|royal-hall|Colin,King,Steward@wide@Colin performs an absurdly stiff bow in the open floor before King.|Colin@medium@Colin repeats the bow with one clearly comic tilted foot, stable balanced adult body.|King@close_up@King breaks into a small open-mouth laugh.|Steward@close_up@Steward follows King's laughter, shoulders relaxed.

16|royal-hall|Colin@close_up@Colin notices the order in which the listeners begin smiling.|King,Steward@medium@Steward looks toward King before showing amusement.|King@close_up@King returns to a neutral expression as his attention shifts.|Colin@medium@Colin slows the routine and lowers the staff when the room's mood changes.

17|service-corridor|Colin@wide@Colin returns to the bench after performing and rests the marotte beside him.|Colin@close_up@Colin checks a loose bell seam carefully with small mitten fingers.|-@insert@The marotte lies beside a plain folded cleaning cloth on the service bench.|Steward@medium@Steward passes through the corridor carrying household papers toward the busy hall.

18|service-corridor|Steward,Colin@medium@Steward speaks privately to Colin beside the bench, pointing briefly toward the hall.|Colin@close_up@Colin listens with a small conciliatory expression.|Steward@close_up@Steward lowers the pointing hand and looks less annoyed.|Colin,Steward@medium@Colin nods agreement while keeping his marotte lowered respectfully.

19|service-corridor|Colin@medium@Colin straightens his hood and rehearses a controlled hand gesture, clearly a skilled adult performer.|-@insert@The costume is folded neatly on the bench in an illustrative object view, no person or body exposed.|Colin@close_up@Colin calmly adjusts the marotte's position for his next routine.|Colin@medium@Colin makes a small practiced bow with focused concentration rather than involuntary movement.

20|service-corridor|-@insert@A plain manuscript on the bench contains an abstract little fool drawing, no readable text or historical portrait.|Colin@medium@Colin points at the simple drawing while holding his own staff for comparison.|-@insert@The drawn mock staff on the page is clearly a symbolic sketch beside the real wooden prop.|Colin@close_up@Colin studies the page with a thoughtful tiny mouth, no extra imaginary figures.

21|service-corridor|-@insert@A closed later-looking illustrated book and a plain fool staff rest separately on the bench, no title or named portrait.|-@close_up@A small generic theatre curtain sketch appears on one open page, no lettering or recognizable historical individual.|Colin@medium@Colin closes the book and returns attention to the actual marotte in his hand.|Colin@close_up@Colin looks doubtful at an entertaining story, dot eyes small and face round.

22|royal-courtyard|Steward@wide@Steward examines one delayed delivery crate beside the courtyard cart.|Steward,Colin@medium@Steward raises a frustrated open hand as Colin approaches in his usual costume.|Colin@close_up@Colin notices the irritation and stops before starting his imitation.|Colin@medium@Colin lowers the marotte and abandons the planned grand announcing gesture.

23|royal-hall|Colin,King@medium@Colin offers an exaggeratedly reverent bow toward King while keeping a respectful gap.|King@close_up@King looks mildly pleased but not yet amused.|Colin@close_up@Colin checks the response and adjusts his timing.|Colin@medium@Colin waits with the marotte upright, letting the absurd solemnity become apparent.

24|royal-hall|Colin,King,Steward@wide@Return to the opening awkward moment, Colin centre, King right and Steward left.|King@close_up@King watches unsmiling, eyes on Colin off frame.|Colin@medium@Colin bows formally toward his own marotte instead of explaining the failed line.|Colin@insert@The marotte's cheerful tiny face stays fixed as Colin's mitten hand holds the staff steady.

25|royal-hall|Colin@medium@Colin stretches the absurd consultation with the wooden fool head.|Colin@wide@Colin turns a pompous bow into an awkward retreat, upright balance and both feet visible.|King@close_up@King finally laughs, no cruel or threatening expression.|Steward@close_up@Steward joins in with a small relieved smile.

26|service-corridor|Colin@medium@Colin returns to the corridor pleased but tired and sits on the bench.|Steward,Colin@medium@Steward asks Colin about another appearance and Colin raises a practical questioning hand.|Colin@close_up@Colin listens for the details of the next gathering.|Colin@medium@Colin checks his marotte and prepares patiently rather than rushing through the doorway.

27|royal-hall|Colin,King@wide@Colin performs confidently at a respectful distance from the raised chair.|-@insert@One hood bell and the plain marotte head appear together as work accessories, no text.|King,Steward@medium@King and Steward react differently to a small comic gesture off frame.|Colin@close_up@Colin reads those reactions carefully before choosing his next movement.

28|service-corridor|Colin@medium@Colin holds the mock staff upright and studies the tiny fool face.|Colin@insert@Both mitten hands check that the wooden head is firmly fixed to the staff.|Colin,Steward@medium@Colin waits beside the bench as Steward opens the route toward the hall.|Colin@wide@Colin stands ready with quiet confidence, facing the unchanged doorway and the next audience.
